details.cardSet: Combined Set "Banquet of Dreams & Trial of the Omens"
details.effect: [fanfare] Summon 2 One-Tailed Fox tokens. [fanfare] [cost02]: Summon a One-Tailed Fox token. Give each other Yokai follower on your field [attack]+1. Whenever another Yokai follower you control leaves the field, select an enemy follower on the field. Deal 1 damage to it and its leader.

issues: The first fanfare incorrectly summons 2 One-Tailed Fox tokens into the EX area. It should summon 2 One-Tailed Fox tokens onto your field (`zone: "field"`).
The optional [cost02] fanfare incorrectly summons the extra One-Tailed Fox token into the EX area. It should summon that token onto your field (`zone: "field"`).

The last ability is encoded with the wrong timing and missing restrictions/targeting. It should trigger when another Yokai follower you control leaves the field, not on this card's own `onLeaveField`, and it should select an enemy follower, then deal 1 damage to it and its leader.

The last ability uses invalid/inaccurate effect encoding. Replace `dealDamageFollowerAndLeader`/`dealDamageOtherFollowers` style with `damageFollowerAndLeader` including the required enemy follower selection, or equivalent correct targeting structure supported by the DSL.

details.effect: Select an enemy follower on the field and deal it 2 damage. If there is a Gilnelise, Omen of Craving on your field, banish the selected follower instead.

issues: The spell is incorrectly encoded as an unconditional `choose` between dealing 2 damage and banishing. It should always select an enemy follower and deal it 2 damage, then if there is a Gilnelise, Omen of Craving on your field, banish that selected follower instead.
The card is missing the named-follower condition. Encode the banish clause with a condition like `namedFollowerOnFieldByName` for `Gilnelise, Omen of Craving` after selecting the target.
